content: dxcam (Desktop Duplication API) is ~240Hz vs mss ~30-60Hz on Windows and can capture D3D exclusive fullscreen. CRITICAL GOTCHA: dxcam.grab() returns None when no NEW frame arrived since last call (issue #104) — a static/AFK game screen yields None, which a naive poller misreads as 'lost vision'. Fix: grab(new_frame_only=False). One DXCamera instance per output/monitor; device_idx/output_idx select the GPU/monitor. Known conflict: importing OpenCV before dxcam can produce black frames (issue #31). mss indexes monitors as monitors[1..n], monitors[0]=virtual union; on multi-monitor the virtual desktop can have negative left/top coordinates. Non-DPI-aware Python processes get logical (scaled) coords from GetWindowRect while the screenshot buffer is in physical pixels — misaligned crop regions. Fix: call SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2) before any UI/coordinate API.
